meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会以 Git 专家身份处理代码提交:先分析仓库现状和提交风格,再把改动拆成多个有逻辑的小提交,而不是一个大提交;也能整理提交历史(变基/压缩),或追溯某行代码是谁写的、何时加的。
howto.when: 当你发出 git 相关请求时触发,比如说“commit”“rebase”“squash”,或问某段代码是谁写、何时加的等历史问题;按说明任何 git 操作都应使用它。

say.text: 帮我提交这些改动,拆成几个有逻辑的小提交。
say.note: Claude 会按原子单位拆分并沿用仓库提交风格。

say.text: 把最近三个提交压缩成一个,提交信息写清楚。
say.note: 触发 rebase/squash 历史整理。

say.text: 查一下 login 这段代码是谁写的、什么时候加的。
say.note: 触发历史查找,定位来源提交。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a Git expert: it inspects the repo state and commit style, then splits file changes into multiple small, atomic commits instead of one big commit. It can also rewrite history (rebase/squash) and trace who wrote a line of code or when a change was added.
howto.when_en: Triggered by git-related requests, e.g. saying 'commit', 'rebase' or 'squash', or asking who wrote a line / when a feature was added. Per its description, it should be used for any git operation.

say_en.text: Commit these changes, split into logical small commits.
say_en.note: It will split by atomic unit and match repo commit style.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one, with a clear message.
Find who wrote this login code and when it was added.
say_en.note: Triggers history search to locate the source commit.
